thread:
jamie: hey team — first week here, small snag. trying to run the onboarding training VM from the internal learning portal but the MDM enrollment on my personal Mac keeps failing with a signature error. do i need to use a company laptop for the sandbox exercises (they ask us to use a dataset marked ‘sensitive-sim’)? @olivia @it-support

olivia: welcome jamie! :wave: you should be able to do the training on a personal device if you follow the BYOD checklist, but the sensitive-sim dataset is allowed only under a supervised training exception. see the short policy here: https://intranet.redwood/sec/byod-policy (TL;DR: disk encryption + up-to-date OS + MDM enrolled).

it-support: hi @jamie — can you paste the exact error? also which macOS version?

jamie: sure — macOS 13.6.2. installer fails after "Verifying package" with: 
```
installer: Package integrity check failed (signature invalid)
```
no VPN running. ran installer twice.

it-support: thanks. try reinstalling the bootstrap profile from https://setup.redwood/internal-mdm and then run:
```bash
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
if that doesn't work, paste the installer log from /var/log/install.log and we'll triage.

riley: adding a note — if you can't get MDM enrolled quickly, we can grant a limited training exception that blocks the synthetic data with realistic PII flags (so you still can do the flow without the sensitive-sim). it's a short form from people-ops.

jamie: that would be great, thanks. how long do exceptions usually take?

olivia: typical turnaround is same-day if it's just a training exception. we'll need a screenshot of the installer error, your laptop model, and confirmation you have FileVault on. i'll DM the exception form link.

security: quick heads-up — the training VM has telemetry and safeguards, but please do not copy any sandbox data off-machine. exception will include a short attestation for this.

jamie: got it — attaching screenshot now. thanks all. 

security-bot: SECURITY ALERT: If you receive an email requesting credentials for onboarding, do NOT reply. PhishSim will email you after day 7 for a test. Report suspicious messages to #eng-security.

it-support: received the screenshot. trying a remote push now. if enroll fails, i'll open a support ticket and escalate to MDM vendor.

olivia: tagging @riley — please pre-approve the training exception so jamie can move forward if enroll can't be fixed today. :thumbsup:

riley: pre-approved. jamie — link to the restricted sandbox (no sensitive-sim) will be in your training queue in ~10m. once you confirm you can access it, we can close this thread.

jamie: confirmed — can access restricted sandbox, and ran through lesson 1. thanks everyone! :rocket:
